subject: Planning: Redwood demo during Aurora site visit — schedule options

Cc: Linda Park <linda@auroralabs.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Planning: Redwood demo during Aurora site visit — schedule options

Hi Ethan / Linda,

Thanks again for taking the meeting last week — excited to show a brief onsite walkthrough while your team is at the San Mateo office the week of Aug 8. Based on the attendee list you shared, I want to propose two options so we can lock a time that fits your travel plans: 

- Option A: Mon, Aug 9 — 10:00–11:00am PT (onsite, full technical demo + Q&A)
- Option B: Thu, Aug 12 — 2:00–3:30pm PT (onsite, longer session to include integration planning)

If folks are traveling on different legs, we can also do a short exec briefing (30m) for remote stakeholders and a separate deep-dive for the onsite engineering group. 

I attached a calendar placeholder (redwood-demo-proposed.ics) with both slots — can you confirm which works for your delegation? If neither, tell me the windows and we’ll rework it.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Planning: Redwood demo during Aurora site visit — schedule options

Hi Naomi,

Appreciate the options — quick update on our side: the execs (VP Eng + CTO) have some last-minute travel adjustments and will be on a customer site Aug 9–10 attending a field pilot. That means Option A is tough for the full team.

We have two preferences:
- Move the full onsite demo to Thu Aug 12 if that still works.
- Or, run a 30-min virtual executive briefing on Aug 9 (their only free window) and schedule the detailed, hands-on session for Aug 12.

Also, can you share a mutual action plan or agenda we can circulate internally? That will help me get approvals for the longer slot. I attached our team itinerary (aurora-itinerary.pdf) so you can see travel windows.

Thanks,
Ethan Walker
Director, Infrastructure Programs | Aurora Labs
ewalker@auroralabs.com | (212) 555-0144

Attachment: aurora-itinerary.pdf

Thanks for the heads up, Ethan — totally understand the change. Looping in Rishi (our solutions lead) and Monica (customer success engineer) so we can propose a concrete plan that matches your travel windows.

Proposed approach:
- Aug 9, 11:30–12:00pm PT — 30m virtual exec briefing (slides + top-level ROI + Qs)
- Aug 12, 2:00–4:00pm PT — onsite technical deep-dive with SE bench (demo, redlines, integration checklist)

If the execs truly only have a 30m window on Aug 9, we’ll use that time for a concise run-through of architecture and go/no-go items and push the hands-on work to Aug 12. Monica can bring an integration checklist and a pre-filled mutual action plan to accelerate sign-off.

Action items for us:
1) Rishi — can you prepare a 2-slide exec summary and confirm availability for Aug 12?
2) Monica — can you draft the mutual action plan and attach here (I’ll link it in the calendar invite)?
3) Ethan / Linda — confirm if Aug 12 2–4pm is good for onsite (or propose a single alternative window).

I’ve also dropped a short Doodle poll in case we need to compare more internal windows -> https://doodle.com/poll/abc123 (quick, optional).

Thanks — Naomi

Hi Naomi / Rishi / Monica,

Aug 12, 2:00–4:00pm PT works for our onsite delegation — please lock that in. The execs want the 30m briefing on Aug 9 but remotely at 11:30am PT, so let’s keep both.

Quick asks before we confirm calendar invites: 
- Please send a one-page mutual action plan I can share with procurement (I gave an initial nod but procurement wants it for the travel approval packet).
- Can you add a short bullet list of prerequisites (network access / test data / VPN) so our infra lead can prep ahead of the onsite?

I’ll send a calendar accept once the invites are updated. Thanks for being flexible here — appreciate the quick turn.

Best,
Ethan
